info.title: Task API
info.description: Implementation contract draft for team review. Work area: Task. See ../conventions.md, ../authentication.md, and ../workflows.md. All examples are synthetic.

servers.description: Local gateway; replace with HTTPS gateway in deployed environment.

get.description: Current member. All active boards, created_at ASC then id ASC; at most five.

post.description: Current member. At most five active boards per workspace, enforced transactionally; 409 BOARD_LIMIT_REACHED. No default boards automatically created.

ETag.description: Quoted integer version; send as If-Match.

get.description: Current member; board must belong to workspace.

ETag.description: Quoted integer version; send as If-Match.

patch.description: Current member. Changes board name, not individual tasks.

ETag.description: Quoted integer version; send as If-Match.

delete.description: Owner only. Atomically hide board/tasks/comments and release board slot; physical cleanup may follow. No task-move event.

get.description: Current member. Optional board_id filters an active board in workspace; otherwise all boards. created_at DESC then id DESC.

post.description: Current member. Title and board required. Optional fields default empty description and null dates/assignee. Validate date ordering and current assignee membership. Task number allocated monotonically per workspace, never reused. Emits task.assigned.v1 if assigned to another user.

ETag.description: Quoted integer version; send as If-Match.

get.description: Current member. Deleted parent board/workspace makes task unavailable. Stale assignment generations render as null.

ETag.description: Quoted integer version; send as If-Match.

patch.summary: Edit task or move to another board
patch.description: Current member. Omitted fields unchanged; null clears dates/assignee, not title/description/board. Validate resulting date pair. board_id moves within workspace only. Unknown fields (status, priority, custom fields) rejected. Same assignee is no-op; unassignment and board moves do not notify. New other assignee emits task.assigned.v1.

ETag.description: Quoted integer version; send as If-Match.

delete.description: Current member. Task/comments become inaccessible; notification records remain historical.

get.description: Current member. created_at ASC then id ASC. Author/mention names are creation-time snapshots.

post.description: Current member. Non-whitespace body. Mention offsets use Unicode code points in the exact body, zero-based and non-overlapping. Each range selects @display text; user ID determines recipient, not text matching. All mentioned users must be current members. Up to 50 ranges and 20 distinct recipients. Duplicate user ranges allowed, one event per distinct non-author recipient. Invalid membership or range: 422. No editing/deleting endpoint.

get.description: Process responds; does not test dependencies.

servers.description: Private direct service probe; not exposed by public gateway.

get.description: Can serve required synchronous operations: database available; Task/Notification can reach Identity. Broker outage alone does not fail readiness if outbox can safely persist. 503 when unavailable.

servers.description: Private direct service probe; not exposed by public gateway.

sessionBearer.description: Opaque application session issued by Google exchange; NOT a Google ID token.

serviceKey.name: X-Service-Key
serviceKey.description: Per-caller secret. Task and Notification have distinct keys and endpoint allowlists.

RequestId.name: X-Request-ID
RequestId.description: Optional correlation UUID; gateway generates/replaces invalid values and echoes a UUID.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated UUID; retain the same value on retry. Scope and 24-hour retention: conventions.md.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong version ETag, e.g. "3". Required on resource PATCH/DELETE. Stale: 412; missing: 428.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the same list, user, and filters. Invalid cursor: 400.

details.reason: Must be on or after start_date.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked credentials.

404.description: Resource does not exist, is deleted, or is hidden from this actor.

409.description: Business conflict, capacity limit, terminal invitation, or idempotency key conflict.
